summary: Tested AI Voice Call Support feature (OpenAI Realtime Voice API) for Enterprise sites. All backend APIs working correctly. Frontend UI elements (Voice Call button, incoming call overlay, decline button) functioning as expected. Enterprise Assistant 3D images loading correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Voice Support router correctly checks clara_enterprise flag before allowing session creation
WebRTC endpoints registered via emergentintegrations library (realtime/session, realtime/negotiate)
VoiceCallWidget.js properly handles all phases: ringing -> connecting -> active -> ended
ClaraAssistant.js includes 'Or call Clara Support' button (line 345-351) that triggers voice call via requestVoiceCall()
MainSiteDashboardLayout.js correctly shows Voice Call button only for Enterprise sites (line 1142-1154)
Enterprise Assistant page loads 3D isometric room images from static.prod-images.emergentagent.com
seed_data_creation: Created voice support sessions during testing (auto-cleaned by user scope)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Voice Support feature is fully working for Enterprise sites. Backend tests in test_voice_support.py cover: start-session (Enterprise), start-session (non-Enterprise 403), realtime/session endpoint, save-transcript, sessions list, session detail, 404 for nonexistent session, unauthenticated 401. Frontend tests verified: Voice Call button visible for radiogroep (Enterprise), Voice Call button NOT visible for dbntstudio (non-Enterprise), incoming call overlay with ringing animation, decline button closes overlay, Enterprise Assistant page with 3D images. WebRTC voice streaming cannot be fully tested in headless browser (requires microphone).
